# tera-config references

Generated schema material for the `tera-config` skill, scoped to the vault-native configuration domain (ADR-064 / ADR-065). Every file here is single-sourced from the Go schema types compiled into the `tera` binary that produced this pack, so it matches that daemon's served schema surface exactly — no fetch, no version skew. A running daemon serves the same content live; the route is noted per file.

## Config kinds

Each vault *config kind* — the flat infrastructure blocks (llm, listeners, workers, auth, mcp upstreams/exposures, …) a deployment authors under `.tera/<kind>/` (PRD-014 J1 / ADR-064) — ships a human-readable reference table of every block, attribute, type, and constraint, reflected from the `pkg/config` runtime block the loader decodes. A config kind has no separate JSON Schema; the reference is the served artifact.

## Machine-output contracts

The plan contract is the JSON `tera config plan --format json` emits and `tera config apply <plan.json>` replays. Read it to drive plan/apply programmatically.

| Contract | JSON Schema | Served at |
|---|---|---|
| `plan` | [machine-output/plan.schema.json](machine-output/plan.schema.json) | `GET /api/v1/schemas/machine-output/plan/{version}` |

## Schema registry catalog

[schema-registry.json](schema-registry.json) is the full ADR-065 catalog: every versioned schema surface the daemon governs, its regime, current + supported versions, Go source, serving location, and migration-chain slot. Surfaces without a served JSON Schema (the deployment manifest, lockfile, and `variables.hcl`) appear here as catalog entries cross-referencing their Go source and ADR. Served live at `GET /api/v1/schemas`.
